Build, parse and inspect security descriptors

security_descriptor.Rd

Security descriptors specify who can read or write a Windows object such as a named pipe. They can be passed to winpipe().

A security descriptor has an owner, a primary group, a DACL (who may access the pipe) and a SACL (auditing and integrity labels). These functions let you construct and convert it to and from an SDDL string.

  • sd_new() creates a security descriptor.

  • sd_add() appends one or more ace()s to the DACL or SACL, creating the ACL.

  • sd_build() turns a descriptor into an SDDL string.

  • sd_parse() turns an SDDL string into a descriptor.

  • sd_default() returns the default DACL of the current token.

Usage

sd_create(..., owner = NULL, group = NULL, dacl = NULL, sacl = NULL)

sd_add(sd, ..., acl = c("dacl", "sacl"))

sd_build(sd)

sd_parse(sddl)

sd_default()

Arguments

...

One or more ace() objects.

owner, group

[character(1)]

Owner and primary group, as an alias, description or SID. If NULL, does not specify an owner or a group.

dacl, sacl

[list]

Optional ACL, a list with flags and aces.

sd

[winpipe_sd]

A security descriptor as created by sd_create().

acl

[character(1)]

Type of ACL to add to the security descriptor. Can be "dacl" or "sacl".

sddl

[character(1)]

An SDDL string.

Value

sd_new(), sd_add(), and sd_parse() return a "winpipe_sd" list. sd_build() and sd_default() return

Details

A parsed descriptor is a list with elements owner, group, dacl, and sacl. Written as a string, a descriptor looks like this:

O:BAG:WDD:(A;IO;GRGW;;;SY)

The prefix specifies the owner, primary group and DACL. Wrapped inside brackets are the individual aces, which specify the DACL configurations. Multiple ACEs can follow each other.

Each ACE is a list with type, flags, rights, object_guid, inherit, account and extra. A NULL DACL means the section is absent, whereas an empty one (flags and aces both empty) grants nobody access.

Examples

x <- sd_new(owner = "admins") |>
  sd_add(ace(rights = "generic all", account = "local system")) |>
  sd_add(ace(rights = c("GR", "GW"), account = "authenticated users"))
#> Error in sd_new(owner = "admins"): could not find function "sd_new"
x
#> Error: object 'x' not found
sd_build(x)
#> Error: object 'x' not found

identical(sd_build(sd_parse(sd_default())), sd_default())
#> Error in sd_parse(sd_default()): Argument `sddl` must be a single string.
